home.future_protocols: Additional protocol smoke surfaces can be added later.
home.lede: A focused browser console for smoke-testing disposable transport fixtures. Open a connection, send a message, and observe the minimal exchange.
home.title: See every connection
home.websocket_description: Minimal handshake, message exchange and close check.
home.protocols_lede: Choose a transport to run its minimal connectivity check.
protocol.graphql.name: GraphQL
protocol.rest.description: Basic HTTP request and response checks
protocol.rest.name: REST
protocol.sse.name: Server-Sent Events
websocket.chat_empty: Send a message to see local send and receive timing.
websocket.chat_note: Times are measured in this browser. The server does not provide sender IDs or network timestamps; every broadcast is shown as received. This view visualizes the fixture exchange, not application semantics.
websocket.connected_hint: Messages are sent as { message } and broadcast to every fixture client. This is a transport signal, not an application feature test.
websocket.disconnected_hint: Connect before sending a JSON message.
websocket.error_hint: Check the event log and connect again.
websocket.lede: Use the fixture to confirm the WebSocket handshake, bidirectional message exchange and close behavior. The broadcast is only a deterministic signal; this does not test rooms, authentication or application rules.
websocket.title: WebSocket
lab.run_to_see: Run a scenario to see the response.
rest.title: REST
rest.lede: Run deterministic request presets to confirm basic HTTP reachability and response handling.
rest.description: Each scenario calls one existing fixture endpoint and renders its method, payload, status and response.
rest.hint: Choose a scenario, review the request, then send it to the same origin.
rest.ready: Request selected. Review it and select Send request.
rest.run_to_see: Send the selected request to see the response.
rest.network_failed: The request could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
graphql.title: GraphQL
graphql.lede: Run minimal query requests to confirm HTTP reachability and a deterministic response.
graphql.description: Presets cover only minimal request/response paths and a validation error; they are not a complete GraphQL compatibility suite.
graphql.hint: Choose a query, review it, then run it as a POST request.
graphql.ready: Query selected. Review it and select Run query.
graphql.completed: Query completed; inspect data or errors.
graphql.failed: Query request returned an error response.
postgres.name: PostgreSQL
postgres.card_description: Run bounded connection and catalog diagnostics against an authorized destination.
postgres.lede: Test one explicitly authorized PostgreSQL destination without sending arbitrary SQL.
postgres.description: Credentials stay in page memory and are sent only when you explicitly run an operation.
postgres.token_help: Use the deployment token configured for this Testkit. It stays only in page memory.
postgres.credential_secret_help: This authenticates to PostgreSQL and is separate from the Testkit access token.
postgres.uri_help: The URI may contain a PostgreSQL password or token and is kept only in page memory.
postgres.capabilities_warning: Capabilities could not be confirmed. Safe defaults remain available.
postgres.destroyed_detail: The retained connection was removed from testkit memory and closed.
postgres.network_failed: The diagnostic API could not be reached. Check the Testkit service and try again.
postgres.validation_token: Enter the access token configured for this Testkit deployment.
postgres.validation_credential_secret: Enter the PostgreSQL password or authentication token.
postgres.validation_database: Enter the initial database required by this deployment.
postgres.validation_uri: Enter a valid postgres:// or postgresql:// URI with a host.
postgres.result_success_detail: The bounded PostgreSQL operation completed successfully.
postgres.result_unauthorized_detail: Check the deployment token used to access this Testkit and try again.
postgres.result_authentication_failed_de: Check the PostgreSQL user and database credential, then try again.
postgres.result_database_unavailable_det: Check the database name and whether this user can connect to it.
postgres.result_tls_failed_detail: Check the server name, TLS mode, and private CA certificate.
postgres.result_timeout_detail: Check reachability and retry. The diagnostic stopped at its bounded deadline.
postgres.result_connection_failed_detail: Check the destination, port, TLS settings, and network reachability.
postgres.result_invalid_detail: Review the highlighted connection fields and supported capabilities.
postgres.result_failed_detail: Use the technical code and JSON details to correct the configuration, then retry.
postgres.clear_partial: Local credentials cleared; connection still retained
postgres.clear_partial_detail: Re-enter the Testkit access token and destroy the retained connection, or wait for its expiry.
sse.title: Server-Sent Events
sse.lede: Open a bounded browser stream to confirm event delivery and inspect the minimal stream contract.
sse.description: Connections are explicit: connect, observe status events, disconnect, then reconnect when you choose. This is a connectivity check, not a general streaming feature test.
sse.connected_hint: Receiving status events from the same origin.
sse.disconnected_hint: Connect to open the event stream.
sse.error_hint: The stream stopped. Connect again to retry explicitly.
